children: ICICI Securities's research report on GR Infraprojects

GR Infra (GR) has picked up execution with H1 revenue growth of 45% YoY vs its guidance of 15–20% for the fiscal. Revenue growth guidance is now revised to 25%, implying ~10% revenue growth for H2FY27 – we believe, this could be exceeded. But new order wins remained elusive in H1. GR guides for order inflows (OI) of INR 200–220bn for the year, which it remains confident of achieving given the big-ticket projects in the pipeline, particularly from the roads segment. Its order book (OB) stands at INR 245bn (2.7x TTM sales). The company is yet to start execution on projects worth INR 36bn (not part of OB), which it had won in Q4FY26. GR is also evaluating monetisation of a few HAM projects by end-FY27, wherein the equity invested stands at ~INR 12bn. Maintain BUY with a revised TP of INR 1,200.

Given a pick-up in execution, and the possibility of liquidation of operational assets, we maintain BUY on the stock with a revised target price of INR 1,200. We have trimmed our multiple of 7x vs. earlier 8x given the subdued order wins in H1FY27. Order inflows remain crucial for sustainable revenue growth over medium term.
